description: The bar chart titled “Evaluation Based on Different Tasks” illustrates accuracy values for three methods across two evaluation tasks. The horizontal axis contains the task categories “MCQ Eval” and “Generation Eval,” arranged left to right, and the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” with a linear scale spanning from 0.0 up to about 0.7, with regularly spaced tick marks at approximately 0.2 intervals (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6). For “MCQ Eval,” there is an orange bar labeled “Base” with an annotated value of 0.644, and a stacked bar composed of a pale yellow bottom segment labeled “RMU” with value 0.299 and a light green top segment labeled “RMU with Enhanced GCG” with value 0.539 (the total height indicated by the top annotation). For “Generation Eval,” the orange “Base” bar is annotated as 0.597, and the stacked bar shows a pale yellow “RMU” segment annotated 0.106 with a light green “RMU with Enhanced GCG” segment reaching an annotated total of 0.263. The legend centered below the plot maps colors to methods (orange = Base, light green = RMU with Enhanced GCG, pale yellow = RMU), and the bars are not shown as sorted beyond the left-to-right task order, with numeric value labels placed above the relevant bar tops (and within/near the stacked components).
